name: missing-documents-become-a-task
pins: PRD stories 26 and 27. Neurology requires a prior MRI or CT report, which this patient does not have. The shortfall must reach the patient in the reply *and* outlive the conversation as a follow-up task — a missing-documents list that exists only in a sentence is lost the moment the chat ends. This scenario exists because the diff and its consumers had silently disagreed on a key name, so the task was never created and the patient was told nothing was needed.

turns.message: I need a neurology appointment next week
